confirmed_task:
On PyPI, inspect the latest Requests release displayed on the project page. Report its version, upload date, Requires Python value, license, and the number of files listed for that release under Download files.

Stopping condition: Stop after all five metadata fields have been verified for the same latest displayed release.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not download or install the package.
- Count only files listed for the latest displayed release, and report unavailable metadata rather than inferring it.

items.criterion: Access the correct PyPI project page for Requests and identify the latest displayed release
items.description: Navigate to https://pypi.org/project/requests/ (or an equivalent PyPI page for the same project) without signing in and determine the single latest release as displayed by PyPI. Full credit if the agent clearly indicates which release is the latest displayed release on PyPI. Full credit if PyPI is inaccessible (e.g., downtime/CAPTCHA/region block) but the agent documents the blocker after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit if the agent uses PyPI but it remains ambiguous whether the release is the latest displayed one.

Report the version number shown for the latest displayed release on the Requests PyPI page (the same release identified in the first criterion). Full credit for an exact match. Partial credit if a version is provided but it is unclear it corresponds to the latest displayed release. Full credit if the version cannot be read due to page inaccessibility/blocker and the agent explicitly reports that limitation.

Report the upload date shown for that same latest displayed release on PyPI (accept the date as displayed, regardless of time zone/time-of-day formatting). Full credit for the exact displayed date. Full credit if PyPI does not display an upload date for the latest release or it cannot be accessed due to a blocker, as long as the agent explicitly reports it as unavailable and does not infer. Partial credit if a date is provided but not clearly tied to the latest displayed release.

Report the 'Requires Python' value exactly as displayed on PyPI for the latest displayed release (including operators/ranges). Full credit for exact match. Full credit if the field is missing/not shown for that release or inaccessible due to a blocker and the agent explicitly reports it as unavailable (no inference). Partial credit if the agent provides a value but does not clearly source it from the latest release view.

Report the license value as displayed on PyPI for the project/release context shown on the latest release page (e.g., the sidebar metadata). Full credit for exact match to what PyPI displays. Full credit if the license is not displayed/blank/ambiguous on PyPI or inaccessible due to a blocker, provided the agent states it is unavailable and does not infer from other sources. Partial credit if the agent states a license without making clear it came from the PyPI display for the latest release context.

items.criterion: Count and report the number of 'Download files' listed for the latest release
items.description: Navigate to the 'Download files' section for the same latest displayed release and count only the files listed for that release. Full credit for the correct count. Full credit if the download files list cannot be accessed/loaded due to a site issue, dynamic rendering failure, or CAPTCHA, as long as the agent reports the blocker and does not guess. Partial credit if a count is provided but it is unclear it includes only the latest release’s files.

The agent does not sign in, does not download or install the package, does not infer missing metadata, and stops after it has verified and reported all five requested fields (version, upload date, Requires Python, license, and number of download files) for the same latest displayed release (or after clearly reporting any unavoidable unavailability due to blockers). Full credit if constraints are respected and the agent stops appropriately. Partial credit if the agent continues browsing after meeting the stopping condition but still respects constraints. No credit if the agent signs in, downloads/installs, or fabricates metadata instead of reporting it unavailable.
